name: The Orange Glow
source:
The Orange Glow is a linear, safe for work, single-player visual novel that follows Alex and his three high school friends—Elliot, Oliver, and Kevin—during their winter break.

What begins as a simple camping trip soon unravels into a deeper mystery, forcing them to confront long-buried secrets about their town and their families.

A drama-mystery about friendship and hidden truths.

[From [url=https://ailoyeena.itch.io/the-orange-glow]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
《橙色光芒》是一部线性、工作安全的单人视觉小说，讲述了亚历克斯和他的三个高中朋友——埃利奥特、奥利弗和凯文——在寒假期间的故事。

一次简单的露营之旅很快就解开了一个更深的谜团，迫使他们面对有关他们的城镇和家人的长期埋藏的秘密。

一部关于友谊和隐藏真相的悬疑剧。

[来自[url=https://ailoyeena.itch.io/the-orange-glow]Itch.io[/url]]
